bends.note: angle point: Fairview runs south from the University Place junction, then turns SW (diagonal) down to McMillan

ends.note: east end: the not-open street is outlined and closed by a line at x~5340, just short of block 6

notes: Printed names: 'STRAIGHT', 'FAIRVIEW AV.' (east of University Pl.), 'UNIVERSITY PL.', 'FAIRVIEW' + 'AV.' (the N-S piece and the SW diagonal), 'WESTVIEW AV.' (printed as one word), 'RAVINE', 'HERMAN (NOT OPEN)', 'GUY', 'W. McMILLAN'; suffix-less names written with 'Street' (Herman Street is not open). Straight runs in from 257 along a retaining wall (north line y~3550, south line ~3917) and ends at the University Place junction, where the street continues east as Fairview Avenue; Fairview Avenue also leaves that junction southward (60', x~3800-4172), bends SW at y~5441 and runs diagonally down to McMillan. The junction is recorded three times at one point (University Place x Straight, University Place x Fairview, Straight x Fairview) because of the name change. University Place (50') runs north to the edge of the mapped area (continuous line y~330, sheet 277/278 above), no end recorded. Ravine Street here is the 60' street from Straight south across Fairview to McMillan (x~1100-1460); it is NOT in line with the Ravine Street north of Straight on 257 (that one meets Straight ~1,500 px further west, beyond the No Name street and block 3), so the two pieces of Ravine are offset along Straight. Fairview's diagonal, Ravine and McMillan meet in a compressed junction at the bottom left: three separate centreline crossings are recorded (Fairview/Ravine, Ravine/McMillan, Fairview/McMillan). Fairview does not cross McMillan in line: sheet 250 shows the piece south of McMillan meeting it ~127 px further east, and names this (north) piece 'Fairview Avenue (north of McMillan)'; so the Fairview/McMillan point is a T and is recorded twice at the same spot, once as 'Fairview Avenue' (the name printed here, which carries the street up to University Place) and once as 'Fairview Avenue (north of McMillan)' to join 250; McMillan centre from its north line (y~7450) plus 60' and the water pipe (y~7633); Ravine continues south onto 250 (cross, as on 250). Herman/Fairview point is where Herman's centreline (y~5596) meets the diagonal Fairview centreline (Fairview's mouth is wide there). Guy Street is at the right edge, written 'Guy Street (north of McMillan)' to match sheet 251 (Guy jogs at McMillan: the piece south of McMillan is one street width further west, so Guy/McMillan is a T): only its west line is drawn (x~6091 at Fairview, ~6067 at McMillan); its centre (+184 px for the printed 60') is just inside the paper edge (~6330), so Guy/Fairview and Guy/McMillan are taken from the west line plus half-width; they are also picked on 259 where Guy is drawn whole. North of Fairview the 412 block runs across Guy's line, so Guy ends at Fairview on this sheet (T). Block 1 north of Straight is 'STEEP HILLSIDE' with no streets. Circled figures are grade elevations; dashed double lines are water pipes.
